# Verse Box

> A proposed lower-cost public introduction to Aura building, C-Hours and community participation on Minjerribah and across Redlands.

Canonical website: https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/
Source repository: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-verse-box
Licence: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-verse-box/blob/main/LICENCE.md
Rights: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-verse-box/blob/main/RIGHTS.md
XML sitemap: https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/sitemap.xml

## Public chapters
- [Start here](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/): An introduction to Verse Box and Aura of Intelligence for residents and visitors, with personal choice, learning, privacy and participation explained from the beginning.
- [A first visit](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/experience.html): A first visit, everyday applications, optional expansion packs, recording choices, measurements and digital twins explained in the terms of the Verse Box proposal.
- [Understanding Aura](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/personal-aura.html): Understand a personally owned Aura, individual home choices, public/private/secret information, optional biosensors and Genesis, and the development of a personal AI model.
- [Contribution & public life](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/community.html): The proposal explains a fair go, Joyful Responsible Abundance, Community-Hours, P4A, a community example and the wider possibilities for everyday people.
- [The proposed trial](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/trial.html): The work needed to prepare the proposed Verse Box trial: hosts, equipment, personal handover, contribution, public participation and review.
- [Documents & sources](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/sources.html): Read the complete Verse Box proposal, download its supporting documents and follow the project, technical and policy references.
- [Sitemap](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-verse-box/sitemap.html): Follow the Verse Box guide from its introduction through a first visit, personal Aura choices, contribution, public life and the proposed trial.

The public proposal is a corrected edition removing the withdrawn incomplete flatpack study. Other source files preserve their recorded editions. Historical assumptions do not override the current non-financial C-Hour definition or operator choice. Discovery does not grant extra commercial reuse or AI-training permission. Supplied sources and third-party material retain their rights. Images are generated design concepts.
